hero.name: Salomon Kabongo
hero.lede: Ndi ngibaka, ngenza makebulula, ne ndongesha intelligence artificielle.
hero.description: Mudimu wanyi udi utangila foundation models, AI multimodale, computer vision, intelligence documentaire, dipatula dia ngumu ya science, ne technologie bua miakulu ya Afrika. Ku diambuluisha dia Dr. Kabongo, ndi ndongesha AI ya mudimu mu Anglais, Français, Lingala, Tshiluba ne Swahili.

about.title: Fuma ku kumvua AI, kufika ku kuibaka nawu
about.bio1: Makebulula anyi adi atangila mushindu udi ba systèmes ya AI bakeba, bakangisha ne bapima bijadiki mu miakulu, mikanda, bimfuanyi ne mifundu ya science.
about.bio2: Ndi nkangisha makebulula atangila kudi bena mudimu netu (peer-reviewed) ne ingénierie wa buloba bua bushuwa mu foundation models, AI multimodale, computer vision, intelligence documentaire ne évaluation wa kueyemena. Mudimu eu udi ne brevet américain mupeshibue bua kulama bualu bua busokoka ne kumbusha tshimanyinu tshia bantu mu bimfuanyi.
about.bio3: Makebulula ne dilongesha bidi bitupa bia projet umue: dimanya dia AI didi ne mushinga didi ne bua kuikala dikole, dia mudimu ne dipeteke kupita anu mu Anglais. Ku diambuluisha dia Dr. Kabongo, ndi ndongesha mu Anglais, Français, Lingala, Tshiluba ne Swahili.
about.closing: Makebulula adi apeta tshidi mua kuenzeka. Ingénierie udi uteta tshintu atshi mu buloba bua bushuwa. Dilongesha didi dienza bua dimanya ditambule.

speaking.title: Miyuki, malongesha ne ba présentations
speaking.subtitle: Malongesha a université, baconférence ne ba présentations ya interactif EdTrace mu Anglais ne Français — pamue ne ba enregistrements, ba posters ne mabikila a kuakula.
speaking.topic_1_title: Tshidi AI wa mpindieu mua kuenza — ne tshidiye kayi mua kuenza to
speaking.topic_1_desc: Diumvuija patoke dia bukole bua lelu, mushindu udi upona misangu ya bungi, ne mushindu wa kupima mêyi kakuyi mitoyi ya tshianana.
speaking.topic_2_desc: Mushindu udi miakulu, vision, vidéo ne mikanda bikangama mu ba systèmes ya mushinga — fuma ku masungula a makebulula kufika ku mudimu wa bushuwa.
speaking.topic_3_desc: Tshidi tshikengela bua kuibaka AI pamue ne bua bisumbu bia miakulu ya bungi bia mu Afrika: ba données, évaluation, dibuela ne diabanya.
speaking.topic_4_title: Makebulula ne dikola dia carrière technique
speaking.topic_4_desc: Malongesha a mudimu bua kukeba bena mudimu netu, kupatula mudimu wa bukole, kukolesha lungenyi lua technique ne kuibaka carrière udi ushala.
speaking.invite_body: Tumina organisation anyi événement, bateleji, dituku ne muaba uudi ulongolola, format ne sujet. Ndi ntangila mabikila mu Anglais ne Français, ku bule anyi pa muaba.

consulting.title: Mibelu misungudibue mu AI
consulting.subtitle: Mibelu mitungunuka bua ba équipes badi bangata mapangadika a mushinga mu makebulula a AI, évaluation, architecture ne ba systèmes ya miakulu ya bungi.
consulting.area_1_desc: Dilongolola dia évaluation, dikonkonona dia dipona ne kumona ne bijadiki bikala modèle udi ukumbana bua mudimu wende.
consulting.area_2_desc: Kutangila ne ntema système ya AI, plan wa makebulula anyi njila wa technique kumpala kua équipe kupesha dîba ne ba ressources ya bungi.
consulting.area_3_title: AI ya miakulu ya bungi ne miakulu ya Afrika
consulting.area_3_desc: Stratégie wa ba données, évaluation, disungula dia ba modèles ne ba méthodes idi inemeka bisumbu bua bintu bia miakulu ya bungi ne nsombelu wa mu Afrika.
consulting.area_4_desc: Malongesha malongolola bua kuambuluisha ba équipes ya makebulula ne ingénierie bamvue méthode, bafuanyikije masungula anyi bumvuangane bua njila wa AI.
consulting.format_1_title: Muyuki wa mibelu wa musangu umue
consulting.format_1_desc: Muyuki mutungunuka bua kumvuija lukonko, kuteta dipangadika anyi kumanya bitupa bidi bilonda.
consulting.format_2_desc: Évaluation udi ne mikalu patoke wa système, ba données, architecture, plan wa évaluation anyi njila wa makebulula.
consulting.format_3_desc: Mudimu wa tshikondo tshîpi ne lukonko, bateleji, tshintu tshia kupesha ne dituku dia ndekelu bidi bijadika bimpe.
consulting.boundary_body: Midimu idi isadila ngumu ya bantu bonso anyi ya client ne kayiyi isangisha mudimu wa busokoka, wa muntu mukuabu anyi udi utangila mfumu wanyi wa mudimu. Dilomba dionso didi dipita mu dikonkonona dia matandu a majinga ne mu manyisha onso adi akengela. Mibelu idi ipeshibua anu mu dîna dianyi nkayanyi: kayena ipeshibua, kayena ikuata contrat, anyi kayena ifutshibua ku diambuluisha dia kampuni yonso ingakabanga anyi bia mudimu biayi to.
consulting.cta_body: Tumina organisation anyi secteur webe, lukonko, diandamuna diudi ukeba, calendrier ne matandu onso a majinga adi mua kuikala. Ndi ngitaba anu midimu mikese idi ne mikalu patoke.
